children: Indu Bhan New Delhi: The Supreme Court on Thursday closed the mediation proceedings in the inheritance dispute among industrialist Sunjay Kapur's widow Priya, mother Rani and his children over the ownership of the RK Family Trust, after the family members failed to reach a settlement. The apex court had in May appointed former Chief Justice of India DY Chandrachud as the mediator to help resolve the family dispute over the ownership of the trust, which holds a stake in Sona Group flagship Sona BLW Precision Forgings (Sona Comstar). The mediation reached an impasse despite 15 sittings, the retired judge said in his latest report, prompting the SC to end the settlement process and proceed with the hearing of the dispute.

title: Sunjay Kapur Trust Row Returns to SC After Mediation Fails
